claims.quote: When the map holds the named functions each test ran, a script whose changed lines are all in named functions, or in imports, types, comments, and constants of its own, picks only the tests that ran one of those functions.
A changed line belongs to the innermost named function around it, which a test reaches whenever it reaches the anonymous ones inside
a changed constant of the file's own touches the named functions that mention it
A function no test ran is read as its whole file.
No map was written: make the tests pass, with nothing else running, and map again.

The named functions that ran as the imports loaded, such as those that build the library's functions. A function they built runs in the tests with no name of its own, so a change inside it reaches the tests through the function that built it.

A name as V8 reports it, read as the parse names the function: without the suffix a bundler adds to keep names apart, the word an accessor or a bound function starts with, or the object a property is written in, as `module.add` is the property `add`.
A filter that fails whatever ?x is, such as the tail of an empty list, is refused when the invariant is declared, before the facts or after them.
